_readme: Global settings. Form-specific settings (screen code, tab order, field map) live in forms/<FORM>.json.

entry._comment: clear_before_type replaces anything Drake pre-fills (e.g. from its EIN database) with the source value, and notes it in the audit trail.

verify._comment: readback_method: auto (UI Automation, then clipboard), uia, or clipboard.

import_1099._comment: import-1099: require_recalc refuses the import when LibreOffice can't recalculate the workpaper (set false on a PC without LibreOffice; the Python tie-outs still gate the import).
